question: Does the unchanged portable recovery policy make its already-specified confirm-prone to establish-distal-support transition after twelve accepted native observations, and is the resulting first active command applied by genuine MuJoCo on outer step thirteen with non-zero native impulse while the paired matched-zero arm remains unactuated?

controlled_change.changed_surface: Add only a compact decision worker, contract, audit, and wrappers that observe the first already-implemented active native command. The portable controller, native route, model, initializer, observer, thresholds, margins, selector, and physical semantics are unchanged.

threshold_and_margin_authority.entry_prone_confirm_steps_provenance: The immutable R24D17 physical profile and unchanged production core require twelve consecutive entry-prone observations before transition. R24D24 observed counts one and two under that exact profile; R24D25 does not choose or tune this value.
threshold_and_margin_authority.active_application_threshold: At least one finite non-zero target velocity and at least one finite non-zero applied native impulse among the exact eight ordered actuators.
threshold_and_margin_authority.active_application_threshold_provenance: Non-zero is an identity test for whether an active command reached the native application, not a behavioral performance threshold. Exact zero remains the matched-zero authority.
threshold_and_margin_authority.adequacy_argument: The question is command-route coverage, not recovery quality. Exact phase, count, order, actuator cardinality, finiteness, and zero-versus-non-zero predicates are sufficient to distinguish application from non-application without adding a performance margin.

selected_development_cell.selection_provenance: The exact deterministic, outcome-exposed development cell closed positive for context, observer, pose, and prone-confirmation routing in R24D24.
selected_development_cell.selection_adequacy: R24D25 extends that same deterministic route only until its first active native application. The initializer consumes no randomness and another seed cannot exercise a different phase threshold, controller branch, request schema, or actuator route. No population claim is made.

derivation: Each outer loop first applies the control planned after the preceding observation.
Post-step observations one through twelve advance prone_confirm_steps_observed from one through twelve.
The twelfth accepted post-step observation transitions memory from confirm_prone to establish_distal_support and plans the first eight-command recovery control.
The next outer loop, index twelve, is therefore the first opportunity for genuine native application of that control.
coverage_manifest: execute the exact R24D24-qualified V2 context and observer route for both paired arms
retain all twelve confirmation observations and the exact phase transition
apply and measure the first establish-distal-support command in the candidate arm
prove the matched-zero arm remains unactuated through the same horizon
retain every native observation, application receipt, portable receipt, and compact decision projection
explicitly_not_covered: controller physical viability beyond the first applied command
ghost_horizon.adequacy: Thirteen steps per arm is the exact shortest physical horizon that can apply the command planned after the twelfth confirming observation. A twelve-step run cannot apply it; a longer run would expose later behavior that this decision neither asks nor evaluates.

execution_valid_requires: both serial arms construct exactly one genuine MuJoCo model and world
both arms retain exactly thirteen observations, native receipts, collector receipts, and portable step receipts
all R24D24-qualified context, observer, route, initializer, mapping, intervention, and portable support invariants pass
the paired V2 evaluation accepts the complete retained traces as a valid physical development trace
the complete full trace, compact projection, manifest, reservation, and supervisor completion publish append-only
positive_requires: both arms record prone confirmation counts one through twelve
both arms first transition from confirm_prone to establish_distal_support after observation twelve
the candidate has exactly one active native application at outer index twelve in establish_distal_support
the active candidate application retains eight target velocities, eight positive force caps, and eight applied impulses
at least one candidate target velocity and one native applied impulse are finite and non-zero
the candidate post-step observation independently reports at least one non-zero applied impulse
the matched-zero arm has no active native application and every observation identifies zero command
both arms retain entry-prone classification through the twelve confirmation samples and respect recovery joint limits on every step
decision_rule.valid_negative: An execution-valid run that fails one or more positive predicates is retained and closed as a development negative. Physics failure remains visible and is not converted into infrastructure invalidity.
decision_rule.invalid_or_incomplete: A source, qualification, schema, route, invariant, publication, operation-lock, or trace-completeness failure is retained as invalid or incomplete and cannot answer the command-application question.

command_coverage_decision_controls: a missing candidate active application is rejected
an active application before index twelve is rejected
an all-zero native impulse application is rejected

physical_opening_conditions: the complete R24D25 development zero-world gate and all twenty-three controls pass
the exact contract, worker, tests, audit, and wrappers are committed and pushed
one official qualification receipt binds that exact clean-pushed source head
local HEAD, upstream main, and live origin/main remain exactly equal and the worktree remains clean
the global locomotion operation lock is held with role physical
only the declared repeatable development cell opens and paired arms execute serially
all evidence is written append-only under the declared durable evidence root
